6f19986e7cd26c58.description: About the Role Limo, a Saudi ride-hailing platform expanding across the Kingdom, is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer (Python / Django). This part-time position is based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves taking hands-on ownership of backend development, code quality, architecture, and production infrastructure to support growing demand, reliable real-time dispatching, and nationwide expansion. This is a highly technical engineering position requiring an experienced developer capable of deep work within an existing codebase, reviewing other developers' work, troubleshooting complex production issues, and making independent technical decisions. Key Responsibilities Lead hands-on development, maintenance, and optimization of Limo's Python/Django backend, including writing, debugging, reviewing, and optimizing production-level code. Design, develop, and maintain REST APIs and backend services for Android and iOS applications. Review pull requests, enforcing coding standards, security, maintainability, and performance, and guiding other developers through technical decisions and code reviews. Improve backend architecture to support increasing users, drivers, concurrent requests, and transactions, optimizing Django ORM, SQL queries, database transactions, indexing, and connection management. Develop and maintain backend services for ride requests, driver availability, rider-driver matching, and trip lifecycle management, including troubleshooting dispatch algorithms and working with geolocation features. Manage and optimize production backend infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), troubleshooting application servers, networking, deployments, and monitoring infrastructure health. Maintain and optimize MySQL databases, queries, and indexes, implementing and troubleshooting Redis caching and distributed-system patterns. Troubleshoot backend integrations with Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) applications, investigating API integration, authentication, data synchronization, and push notification issues. Required Qualifications At least 8 years of professional software development experience, including substantial backend engineering experience. Strong Python and Django expertise, including Django ORM, middleware, authentication, permissions, migrations, transactions, and performance optimization. Extensive experience designing, developing, and troubleshooting REST APIs. Strong MySQL and SQL skills, including query optimization, indexing, database locking, and transaction management. Practical experience with Redis, caching, queues, background jobs, and asynchronous processing. Experience deploying and maintaining production systems on Google Cloud Platform or a comparable cloud environment. Ability to independently read, debug, review, and improve complex existing codebases. Experience diagnosing production incidents and implementing reliable technical solutions. Strong understanding of application security, software architecture, scalability, and performance. Experience with Git, pull requests, automated testing, Docker, CI/CD, and production deployments. Ability to make independent technical decisions and provide hands-on technical leadership. Strong English communication skills. Preferred Industry and Technical Experience Experience with ride-hailing and on-demand platforms, geolocation and mapping, and real-time dispatch systems. Familiarity with high-concurrency systems and real-time communication technologies. Experience with GCP, Cloudflare, DNS, CDN, WAF, networking, monitoring, and production security. Troubleshooting backend integrations with Kotlin-based Android and Swift-based iOS applications. Application Process Candidates should submit their CV along with a brief summary detailing their experience with production systems developed or maintained using Python and Django, MySQL, Redis, Google Cloud, and backend scalability. Please also include a challenging production issue personally investigated and resolved, and any experience with geolocation, real-time dispatching, ride-hailing, or similar high-volume platforms.

6fc6746ceecd4671.description: About Red Sea Global Red Sea Global (RSG) is a developer focused on shaping living, working, and travel environments. 6fa7c759cceb1894.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات في الرياض عن مدير إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها بدوام كامل. يتولى مدير إدارة المشاريع الإشراف العام على أنشطة إدارة المشاريع والبرامج، ويضمن تحقيق الأهداف المحددة ضمن الجداول الزمنية والميزانيات المخصصة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج، ومتابعة تقدير الميزانيات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية والمعدات اللازمة. ضمان توفير الموارد في الوقت المناسب وضمن التكلفة المقدرة، وتحديد افتراضات المشروع والتداخلات البينية مع المشاريع الأخرى. تحديد مخاطر المشروع ووضع الخطوات اللازمة لتفاديها وحلها بفعالية. التنسيق مع فريق العمل لمراجعة الأعمال المنجزة والمراحل المتبقية، والتأكد من الالتزام بنطاق المشروع ومعايير إدارة الجودة المعتمدة. إدارة عمليات التغيير بناءً على الخطط الموضوعة، وتنسيق ومتابعة عمليات إنهاء المراحل الرئيسية للمشروع وإغلاقه. تقييم مستوى تحقيق مخرجات المشروع لأهدافه الرئيسية، وضمان نقل المعارف والخبرات وتوثيق كافة الوثائق والتقارير الخاصة بالمشروع. الإشراف على إعداد تقارير سير المشروع، وتقارير إدارة التحديات والمخاطر، وتقارير قياس مؤشرات الأداء بشكل دوري. رفع التقارير المتعلقة لمختلف الأطراف المعنية في المشروع والإدارة العليا. المهارات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في إدارة المشاريع. فهم عميق لعمليات تطوير وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع والبرامج. القدرة على تقدير الموازنات المالية وتحديد المتطلبات البشرية والتقنية. مهارات ممتازة في تحديد المخاطر ووضع حلول فعالة. القدرة على التنسيق الفعال مع فرق العمل المتعددة. مهارات إعداد التقارير وتقديمها للإدارة العليا. بيئة العمل يعمل مدير إدارة المشاريع في بيئة ديناميكية ضمن شركة مدارات الوسط للمقاولات في الرياض، حيث يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع فرق العمل والإدارة العليا لضمان تحقيق أهداف المشاريع بكفاءة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

6fbd8c8d9c22864c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إي إس كارتس عن سائق سيارة خاص للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب بأمان وفعالية، مع الالتزام التام بالجداول الزمنية وقواعد السلامة المرورية. يمثل هذا الدور فرصة للأفراد ذوي الخبرة المبكرة في القيادة الاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية قيادة السيارة لنقل الركاب مع ضمان الالتزام بالمواعيد المحددة والتبليغ الفوري عن أي تأخير طارئ. الالتزام الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور، وإجراءات الأمن والسلامة، والتأكد من عدم ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء الفحوصات الدورية للسيارة ومعالجة المشكلات البسيطة التي قد تطرأ عليها لضمان جاهزيتها. رفع طلبات الصيانة المتخصصة عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب فحص الخبراء أثناء قيادة السيارة. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال القيادة. رخصة قيادة سارية المفعول. المعرفة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادة ممتازة وسجل قيادة نظيف. القدرة على الالتزام بالمواعيد والجداول الزمنية. مهارات تواصل جيدة. القدرة على إجراء فحوصات وصيانة أساسية للسيارة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة الرياض. يعمل السائق ضمن بيئة مهنية تتطلب الانضباط والالتزام بمعايير الشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

6f785312861ac221.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث الشركة العربية للخدمات الزراعية اراسكو عن أمين مخزن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة. يركز الدور على إدارة استلام وتخزين وصرف المواد والسلع، بالإضافة إلى المشاركة في عمليات الجرد. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد والسلع الواردة إلى المستودع والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المحددة في طلبات الشراء أو التوريد أو العينات. تنظيم وترتيب البضائع والمعدات والمواد الأخرى الموردة إلى المستودع، ووضعها في أماكنها الصحيحة مع تثبيت البيانات الخاصة بها. تحضير وتجهيز المواد وصرفها للجهات المعنية بموجب سندات صرف، وذلك وفقاً لآلية الصرف المعتمدة. تحديد الاحتياجات من السلع والمواد عند وصول المخزون إلى حد الطلب، وحفظ جميع معاملات الإدخالات والإخراجات المتعلقة بالمستودع. المشاركة الفعالة في جرد المخزون ومطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي مع أرصدة الدفاتر والسجلات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال أمناء المخازن أو إدارة المستودعات. القدرة على استلام المواد والتحقق من مطابقتها للمواصفات. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لترتيب وتخزين البضائع بكفاءة. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل أمين المخزن ضمن فريق الشركة العربية للخدمات الزراعية اراسكو. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في الشركة العربية للخدمات الزراعية اراسكو.

6f1400821fef3bfe.company_name: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
6f1400821fef3bfe.description: About the Role Systems Arabia is seeking a Red Hat Linux Administrator to join our team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and focuses on maintaining the availability, performance, security, and reliability of Linux environments across development, testing, and production. The ideal candidate will possess strong hands-on experience in RHEL server administration, OS patching, hardening, environment configuration, and production support. Key Responsibilities Administer and support Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) servers across enterprise environments. Perform OS installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and system hardening. Monitor server health, performance, capacity, and availability, and troubleshoot system-level issues. Manage users, groups, permissions, services, filesystems, processes, and system configurations. Support production environments and participate in incident, problem, and change management activities. Implement security best practices, vulnerability remediation, and configuration standards. Automate routine administrative tasks using Shell scripting and/or Ansible. Maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and system configuration records. Qualifications and Experience 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Linux system administration, preferably in enterprise production environments. Strong expertise in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) administration and troubleshooting. Good understanding of Linux networking, filesystems, storage, DNS, SSH, systemd, processes, and permissions. Experience with OS patching, server hardening, vulnerability remediation, and configuration management. Hands-on experience with Shell scripting and/or Ansible. Familiarity with monitoring, logging, backup, and enterprise infrastructure tools. Experience working in 24x7 production support environments and following ITIL-based operational processes. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and incident-management skills. RHCSA/RHCE certification or equivalent experience is an advantage. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, involving support for critical production environments. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6f1c0e2a3afad275.job_title: Sr Eng Pgm Supervisor Saudi National Only
6f1c0e2a3afad275.description: About the Role Honeywell Technologies is seeking a Sr Eng Pgm Supervisor to join its team in Yanbu, Western Area, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is open to Saudi Nationals only and involves leading a multi-disciplined team to achieve strategic growth objectives and manage various operational aspects of programs within the region. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership to a multi-disciplined team, including FSM, FOM, ME Program Manager, and specialists in Service, Projects, and Support, focusing on complex technical equipment and sophisticated products and services. Ensure the organization meets strategic growth objectives by attracting, developing, rewarding, and retaining necessary skills and resources for the LCM Program. Manage all financial aspects of projects within Capex scope and contracts within Opex scope, including orders, revenue, margin, and billing. Deploy growth initiatives and partner with other Honeywell business units (*, HCI, PAS, PMC, HBT) as the focal person for all Honeywell Systems installed in the Yanbu area. Collaborate with the Sales team to drive additional orders and capitalize on business opportunities. Develop and establish operational plans with the Field Service Manager and Field Operations Manager. Communicate with customers according to contract-specific communication plans. Support the Service team in resolving incidents and troubleshooting problems, including managing escalation processes. Review system performance metrics and manage operations accordingly. Manage all projects in Capex scope and all contract entitlements and deliverables in Opex scope for the respective year. Work within the customer’s change management process, serving as the approver for significant change requests and including operational risk/benefit assessments. Participate in pre-outage planning meetings and support On-Process, AMT, and Off-Process Migrations. Review and advise the site on all project activities affecting the control system and ensure documentation is updated. Support the Field Operations Manager in developing and communicating training needs for Honeywell and customer team members. Manage third-party underpinning contracts to ensure cost-effective, appropriate quality, and timely performance. Partner with the FOM and Quality Assurance team to manage the close-out of corrective actions by identifying root causes and updating procedures. Ensure compliance with contract-specific HSE Plans and promote Honeywell’s safety culture. Performance Measurement and Reporting Collaborate with the FSM on Orders, Revenue, Profit, Cash, and Past Dues. Monitor customer satisfaction via NPS Promotor Scope (9 or 10). Track defined HPS safety metrics. Oversee operational SIOP Plan with the FOM and MOS for Opex & Capex delivery. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of relevant experience. Ability to provide strategic leadership to multi-disciplined teams. Strong understanding of financial aspects related to projects and contracts. Experience in deploying growth initiatives and collaborating with various business units. Proficiency in operational planning, customer communication, and incident resolution. Familiarity with change management processes and risk assessment. Knowledge of HSE standards and quality assurance processes. Work Environment This role is based in Yanbu City, Western Area of Saudi Arabia. The position may require irregular working hours to accommodate global time differences for telephone conferences or strategic planning sessions. Offshore visits may also be required based on customer needs.

6f43d337522e9634.description: About Red Sea Global Coastal Contracting Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, is committed to quality craftsmanship, excellence, and service. The company undertakes challenging projects, delivering a range of services through a meticulous approach to project management. Red Sea Global contributes to Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 and aims to lead regenerative tourism, supporting a sustainable future. This full-time position is based in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj or Tabuk, and requires 2-5 years of experience. Role Overview The Assistant Manager Warehouse supports the efficient operation of the Golf Division warehouse. This involves overseeing inventory management, storage, receiving, issuing, and distribution of materials, equipment, and supplies necessary for golf course maintenance and operations. The role ensures inventory accuracy, compliance with safety regulations, cost control, and consistent supply to support operational needs. Key Responsibilities Assist in managing daily warehouse operations, including supervising receiving, inspection, storage, and issuance of materials and equipment. Implement and maintain proper inventory control procedures, monitor stock levels, and initiate replenishment requests to prevent shortages. Verify that all received goods match purchase orders and delivery documentation, ensuring timely issuance of materials to relevant teams. Maintain effective warehouse organization and housekeeping standards. Conduct regular stock counts, cycle counts, and annual inventory audits, maintaining accurate records within the ERP or inventory management system. Monitor slow-moving, obsolete, and damaged inventory, recommending corrective actions, and optimizing inventory levels to minimize carrying costs. Track and manage critical spare parts inventories for irrigation and golf maintenance equipment. Coordinate with Procurement for timely replenishment and assist in preparing material forecasts based on operational requirements. Follow up on outstanding purchase orders and vendor deliveries, coordinating with suppliers regarding schedules and discrepancies. Ensure proper storage and handling of fertilizers, turf chemicals, pesticides, lubricants, fuels, and hazardous materials, monitoring shelf-life and compliance. Maintain records of chemical usage and storage in accordance with company and regulatory requirements. Provide guidance and support to warehouse staff, monitoring productivity and compliance with procedures. Assist in training warehouse personnel on inventory management systems and safe work practices. Prepare inventory, consumption, stock valuation, and warehouse performance reports, analyzing trends and recommending optimization measures. Report stock discrepancies and operational concerns to management. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of relevant experience in warehouse operations or inventory management. Demonstrated understanding of inventory control procedures and warehouse best practices. Experience with ERP or inventory management systems is preferred. Knowledge of safety regulations related to material handling and storage, including hazardous materials. Required Skills Strong organizational and analytical skills. Ability to supervise and provide guidance to warehouse staff. Proficiency in preparing detailed reports and analyzing data. Effective communication and coordination abilities. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Tabuk, with work primarily conducted in Umluj or Tabuk. The role involves working within the Golf Division warehouse, supporting maintenance and operational teams.

6f58ab484899989d.description: About the Role Blue Ocean Corporation is seeking a Sales Associate - Training to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role focuses on promoting training products and services, converting prospective clients into enrolled students, and supporting a positive customer experience throughout the sales process. Role Overview The Sales Associate will be responsible for engaging with potential clients, understanding their training needs, and providing tailored information about available courses. The primary objective is to meet and exceed sales targets by effectively communicating the benefits and details of various training programs. Key Responsibilities Make outbound calls and follow up on leads generated through various marketing channels. Meet and exceed monthly sales targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) by promoting relevant courses. Build client relationships, answer questions, and provide tailored information about courses, schedules, and benefits. Act as the primary client contact during the sales process. Research training needs to tailor the sales approach effectively. Suggest course-offering improvements based on client feedback and market trends. Record all sales activities and client interactions accurately in the CRM system. Required Qualifications Ability to effectively promote training courses. Capability to address prospective clients’ questions regarding program details, schedules, and benefits. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh. Application Process Candidates interested in this Sales Associate - Training role are encouraged to apply.

6f5b4252289e9d6d.description: About the Role Manufacturing Plant - KSA is seeking a Technical Sales Manager I - Saudi National to join their team in Dammam. This full-time role focuses on developing and maintaining market opportunities within the upstream oil and gas sector, primarily for downhole activities. The manager will engage with key stakeholders, including end-users, contractors, and industry associations, to understand technical requirements and qualify solutions. Key Responsibilities Identify, develop, and maintain market development opportunities for upstream oil and gas activities, with a focus on downhole operations. Contact, liaise, and follow up with upstream oil and gas operators to understand their technical requirements and qualify company solutions. Liaise with the sales manager responsible for the commercial plan and collaborate with R&D teams to develop new solutions. Maintain strong working relationships with clients while representing the company's image. Ensure all technical offers for business opportunities comply with customer technical requirements, considering the oil and gas well environment. Provide expert guidance on well design, resolve complex pipe selection and operational failure issues, and create models demonstrating a strong value proposition. Manage a large customer portfolio, prioritizing and addressing customer needs effectively. Independently manage large, complex customers (such as ADNOC, ARAMCO, and international IOCs) with stringent technical requirements, as well as smaller operators. Understand, implement, and adhere to all company commercial and social responsibility policies, ensuring company interests are maintained. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in technical sales or market development within the oil and gas upstream sector, particularly with downhole activities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, requiring engagement with a diverse range of clients and internal teams.

6f8d3abcc6a4fb46.description: About the Role Pace | Architecture, Engineering + Planning is seeking a Contract Administrator to join their team in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing and overseeing all aspects of contract administration for construction projects, ensuring compliance with contractual terms and conditions. The Contract Administrator will lead contractual discussions and advise the client on suitable directions and implementation approaches. Key Responsibilities Act as the main point of contact between project stakeholders and contractors for all contractual matters. Review, interpret, and manage all project contracts, preparing and actioning contractual letters and correspondences. Ensure all project contracts comply with local, national, and international regulations and codes. Monitor contract performance and ensure all parties fulfill their contractual obligations. Identify and assess potential contractual risks, advising the project team on mitigation strategies. Assess and process changes to the original contract scope, including modifications, variations, and additional works. Manage cost adjustments related to changes in project scope, ensuring proper accounting and documentation. Ensure change orders are clearly documented, agreed upon by all parties, and executed in a timely manner. Track and manage claims, disputes, and delays, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with contract terms. Act as a liaison for resolving conflicts, disputes, or issues related to contractual terms and conditions. Coordinate with project managers to ensure work progresses according to the established contract schedule. Collaborate with finance and project teams to track payments, invoicing, and contractual cost management. Maintain and update comprehensive records of contract correspondence, change orders, and amendments. Prepare reports on the status of contracts, risks, and disputes for senior management and other stakeholders. Provide regular updates to senior management regarding financial status, risks, and contract performance. Report to the project director and work with project team members to resolve disputes through negotiation, mediation, or legal proceedings if necessary. Ensure compliance with terms of insurance, bonds, warranties, and other legal requirements. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Law, or a related field. A minimum of 20 years of experience in contract administration. Extensive experience in construction supervision for large-scale infrastructure and/or mega projects, preferably within Saudi Arabia or the GCC region. Work Location This position is based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia, with potential work in Jeddah. Employment Type This is a full-time employment opportunity. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be disclosed during the interview process.

6fb29339f9c7a2d3.description: About the Role Zamil Industrial is seeking an HCM Digital Transformation Senior Specialist to administer, optimize, and continuously improve its Human Capital Management systems. This full-time role, based in Dammam, requires 3-5 years of experience. The successful candidate will collaborate with HR, IT, business stakeholders, and implementation partners to ensure Oracle Fusion HCM effectively supports business processes, maintains high data quality, and enhances the employee and manager experience. Key Responsibilities Administer and support Oracle Fusion HCM modules and daily system operations, including Core HR, Absence Management, Payroll, Recruitment, Performance Management, Goals, Talent Management, Learning, Benefits, Compensation, and Time & Labor. Configure and maintain HCM structures, workforce structures, approval workflows, security roles, and employee self-service processes. Analyze system issues and coordinate resolutions with internal teams, Oracle Support, and implementation partners. Support quarterly Oracle Fusion updates through impact assessments, regression testing, and validation. Identify opportunities to automate and simplify HR processes using Oracle Fusion HCM capabilities. Translate HR business requirements into functional and system requirements, conducting workshops with stakeholders. Prepare and maintain BRDs, functional specifications, process flows, test scenarios, and configuration documentation. Perform fit-gap analysis and recommend solutions based on Oracle standard functionality and leading practices. Support the implementation of new modules, enhancements, integrations, and employee self-service solutions. Develop and maintain HR reports and dashboards using OTBI and BI Publisher, supporting HR management with various analytics. Perform HR data analysis, identify data-quality issues, and support reconciliation and validation across systems. Prepare functional test scenarios and UAT scripts, coordinating and executing CRP, SIT, UAT, and regression testing. Track defects and ensure resolution before production deployment, supporting production migration and post-go-live stabilization. Support Oracle HCM integrations with internal and external systems, working with technical teams on REST APIs, HDL, HSDL, HCM Extracts, and integration requirements. Support mass data uploads, data corrections, and migration activities, performing data validation before and after system changes. Administer Oracle HCM roles and security in accordance with organizational governance, assisting with periodic user-access reviews and role certification. Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and protection of confidential employee information, maintaining documentation and audit trails. Provide functional support to HR teams, managers, and employees, investigating incidents to identify root causes and permanent solutions. Develop user manuals, process guides, FAQs, and training materials, conducting knowledge-transfer and training sessions for HR users. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a combination of HR functional knowledge and strong HR technology capabilities. This role requires an individual who can not only support the HRIS platform but also proactively identify opportunities to automate processes, enhance employee experience, strengthen HR data governance, and maximize the value delivered through Oracle Fusion HCM.

6fb82e52fd448379.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Construction Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing oversight and direction to construction engineers and field personnel on site, ensuring the protection and promotion of company interests and values. The Construction Manager will report to the Senior Construction Manager and will be instrumental in the successful execution of large and complex civils and infrastructure projects. Project Context: Expo 2030 Riyadh This role supports the Expo 2030 Riyadh project, a global platform for collaboration under the theme “Foresight for Tomorrow,” promoting sustainable development and innovation. The event, scheduled from October 2030 to March 2031, anticipates over 40 million visits. Bechtel will manage the infrastructure program for the 6 km2 Masterplan, which includes early works, utilities, and public spaces. The project will transition into a mixed-use legacy development after the event, leveraging international sustainability standards for urban afforestation, treated water, and energy sources. Key Responsibilities Provide construction oversight and ensure compliance of all contractor work activities with project safety, quality plans, schedules, and budgets. Lead ES&H implementation activities on site, conduct joint safety inspections with contractor senior staff, and ensure compliance with regulatory safety codes. Support the Management Team and Customer in developing contracting strategies, including bid evaluation and negotiations. Assist the Senior Construction Manager in managing client-awarded contracts and ensuring contractors meet contractual obligations. Coordinate inputs from various project entities to maintain continuous construction work front availability. Implement project quality management plans, ensuring contractor compliance with quality requirements and execution according to IFC drawings, standards, and specifications. Keep the Delivery Director and Package Manager informed of any changes in contractor activity or cost outside the project scope. Review construction projects and contractor submittals with the Package Manager and oversee on-site works. Review contractor method statements and risk assessments, prepare weekly progress reports, and drive the project to meet deadlines. Direct field staff, fostering their development through performance evaluations and varied assignments. Ensure all required permits and licenses are in place before work commences. Facilitate and manage interfaces with other PMCs, government agencies, clients, internal functions, contractors, and stakeholders. Mentor, motivate, and manage the team and contractors, acting as a role model for behaviors and values. Ensure systematic and complete closure of construction activities. Qualifications and Experience A recognized degree in an engineering or scientific discipline, and/or specialized courses in construction management. Minimum of 17-20 years of experience in construction projects, with a proven track record in large-scale, fast-paced projects. Experience in Saudi Arabia, the Middle East, or GCC region is required. Required Skills Demonstrated strong communication and interpersonal skills to maintain a positive work environment with all parties. Self-motivated with the ability to work independently, exercise professional judgment, and provide sound technical leadership. Experience in fast-paced environments, with the ability to proactively identify problems and propose solutions that do not impact cost, schedule, or quality. High level of written and spoken English skills. Work Environment Construction activities for this project operate on a 24/7 basis, requiring flexibility to work night shifts and weekends as needed. This vacancy is advertised provisionally to assess candidate interest and suitability; any appointment is subject to project approval, business requirements, and the formal selection process.

6fba6ce3c9344110.description: About Almarai Company Almarai Company, established in 1977, is recognized as the world's largest vertically integrated dairy company and a leading food and beverage manufacturing and distribution company in the MENA region. Headquartered in Riyadh, Almarai holds the position of the number one FMCG Brand in MENA and is a market leader across its categories in the GCC, Egypt, and Jordan. The company has a history of providing nutritious products, guided by its principle: “Quality you can trust.” Almarai's product portfolio includes dairy, juices, baked goods, poultry, infant formula, dates, fish and seafood, and bottled water, marketed under more than 20 brands. The company employs over 43,000 individuals across its operational regions. The Opportunity: Stock Controller Almarai is seeking a Stock Controller to join its team in Hail. This full-time role is essential for managing material movements within the in-bound stores, ensuring efficiency and effectiveness in inventory control. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Control and manage the movement of materials within in-bound stores. Ensure effective and efficient handling of all inventory movements. Required Qualifications and Experience High School education. Minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar stock control position. Fluency in English (speaking, writing, and reading). Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint. Compensation and Benefits Almarai offers a competitive compensation package, which includes generous leave, comprehensive medical coverage, a discretionary bonus, and opportunities for training and development.

6fe5d2a0d24b7b9b.description: About Informa PLC and Tahaluf Informa PLC is a global events organizer. Tahaluf, a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF), operates as Saudi Arabia's largest B2B live and on-demand events organizer. Tahaluf is known for organizing large-scale events such as LEAP, Cityscape, Black Hat MEA, and CPHI Middle East, which have made a significant impact on the global events sector. The Role of Marketing Manager, Arabic Speaker (Freelancer) Tahaluf is seeking a Marketing Manager, Arabic Speaker, for a 12-month freelance contract based in Riyadh. This role is responsible for designing and delivering key aspects of the marketing strategy to achieve commercial objectives and revenue targets. The Marketing Manager will focus on brand delivery, accurate customer segmentation, data analytics, campaign planning, and multi-channel optimization. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the marketing strategy, including planning, implementation, and optimization for both inbound and outbound marketing campaigns. Drive online traffic, leads, and conversions to meet strategic KPIs, providing regular updates on results. Analyze visitor and exhibitor digital behavior through continuous testing and reporting on channel and campaign performance, utilizing platforms such as Adobe Analytics and Google Analytics. Benchmark and set new KPI targets to enhance the performance of digital marketing campaigns. Collaborate with supporting agencies to develop the strategy and setup of all paid campaigns. Measure and optimize paid marketing efforts using vendor-specific dashboards, Google Analytics, and marketing analytics reports. Identify evolving SEO practices and work with internal stakeholders and external agencies to develop new digital campaigns. Develop new organic search growth strategies for each stage of the customer lifecycle, considering unique digital trends and platforms across international markets. Collaborate with content marketing and blog contributors to create high-quality content around relevant terms. Manage and improve organic search engine performance and goal-setting based on clickthrough rates, traffic, and conversions. Design and implement testing and optimization strategies, including A/B testing, landing pages, and calls to action (CTAs). Required Experience and Skills 5-10 years of experience in marketing roles. Proven ability to work with line reports and marketing teams to ensure successful delivery of marketing campaigns in line with agreed KPIs, event, and divisional strategy. Experience in line managing digital marketers to successfully implement campaign strategies. Ability to provide guidance, feedback, and inspiration to direct reports. Proficiency in Arabic is required for this role. Work Environment This is a freelance position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a team that fosters collaboration and creativity, contributing to large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team.

6fe7447d8a999113.description: About the Role Red Sea Global is seeking a Director Shared Services for Botanica, a subsidiary specializing in sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. This full-time role is based in Tabuk, with operations spanning Umluj and Tabuk. The Director Shared Services will lead all enabling functions for Botanica, ensuring efficient and compliant operations across various business units. Role Purpose and Context The primary purpose of this role is to oversee Finance & Accounting, Human Resources & Government Relations, Procurement, Administration, and HSSE & Compliance. This includes coordinating IT and systems with the RSG Group. The Director is accountable for accurate financial reporting by business unit, maintaining a controlled cost base, ensuring accurate payroll, managing compliant hiring and retention of a large in-house workforce, and reliable procurement. The role supports a business with multiple revenue streams and a significant in-house field workforce, requiring error-free execution of high-volume processes related to hiring, payroll, residency, permits, accommodation, and procurement. Key Responsibilities Manage financial records, month-end close, management accounts, and contract-level P&L in accordance with accounting standards and RSG Group Finance. Oversee billing, receivables, payables, cash flow forecasting, and banking, ensuring VAT and e-invoicing compliance (ZATCA). Produce P&L by business unit and revenue stream, and support the PMO on budgeting, cost control, and financial modelling. Coordinate internal and external audits and ensure timely resolution of findings. Lead workforce planning and recruitment for all business units, including the in-house landscape maintenance workforce. Manage reward, retention, and engagement programmes, with a focus on critical and hard-to-fill roles. Administer payroll, GOSI, Qiwa, and Muqeem processes, work permits, residency renewals, and Saudization (Nitaqat) compliance. Manage accommodation and welfare standards, training and competency records, and HR policies in coordination with Group HR (SuccessFactors). Set sourcing strategy and manage the procurement lifecycle through the Senior Manager – Procurement, including needs assessment, RFQs, evaluation, purchase orders, and supplier performance. Manage supplier contracts for plants, imports, inputs, equipment, and services in line with procurement policy. Manage office services, document control, records retention, and internal communication systems. Coordinate ERP, HRIS, inventory, and fleet systems with RSG Group IT, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records for staff, contracts, and assets. Ensure data integrity and access controls for financial and personnel data. Lead the Shared Services department (17 FTE) and deliver the fixed responsibilities of a Department Head. Enforce all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, delegation of authority (DoA), processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions. Apply and champion safety, quality, and environmental management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and compliance management systems (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in departmental systems, processes, and practices, focusing on cost reduction, productivity, and client value. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Administration. SOCPA, CMA, CPA, or MBA preferred. Minimum of 15 years of experience, with at least 7 years leading finance, HR, or shared services functions in KSA. Experience supporting a multi-business-unit organization with a large field workforce of several hundred employees.

6fe8d772436f2011.description: المسمى الوظيفي: بائع الهدف من الوظيفة: دعم العمليات اليومية وتحقيق التميز في خدمة العملاء داخل المعرض، مع الالتزام بسياسات الشركة والمحافظة على النظافة العامة والمظهر الجيد وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية: تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة والحفاظ على روح التعاون مع أعضاء الفريق. المساهمة في رفع مبيعات الفرع من خلال متابعة تحقيق الأهداف الشهرية ومقارنتها بالفترة نفسها من العام السابق. الالتزام بساعات العمل الرسمية وبلبس الزي الموحد المعتمد من الشركة. المحافظة على نظافة وتنظيم المعرض في جميع الأوقات. ضمان عدم وجود مخالفات حكومية من خلال الالتزام بجميع التعليمات التشغيلية. متابعة شكاوى العملاء والعمل على تقليلها من خلال تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. المتطلبات: مهارات تواصل فعال ومهارات البيع الالتزام، حسن المظهر وروح الفريق أيام العمل : 6 أيام في الاسبوع الإجازة الاسبوعية: يوم واحد (تكون الإجازة في وسط الاسبوع وليس في الويكيند) العمل بدوام كامل (8 ساعات) (يتم التعيين على شفت واحد سواء مسائي أو صباحي) ☀️ الشفت الصباحي 9 الصباح - 5 المساء 🌙الشفت المسائي 4 مساء - 12 منتصف الليل يمكن أن يتم التنقل بين الفروع القريبة هذه الوظيفة تتطلب استخراج بطاقة صحية (شهادة صحية) بعد التعيين

6fec842131ba0340.description: About Fairmont Hotels & Resorts Fairmont Ramla, Riyadh, is a luxury hospitality destination known for its premium serviced residences, dining experiences, and guest services. As part of the Fairmont brand, the property is committed to maintaining high standards in hospitality. Director Finance & Business Support Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Director Finance & Business Support to lead the Finance Team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves overseeing all financial aspects of the hotel’s operations, ensuring adherence to local and corporate policies, and supervising the daily operations of the Finance office. The Director will drive the company’s financial strategy and planning. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage the hotel’s annual budget, prepare and present financial statements and reports, and provide financial forecasts for strategic decisions. Provide financial insights and analysis to operational teams to enhance performance and implement cost control measures to maintain profitability. Ensure adherence to financial regulations and standards, and identify and manage financial risks associated with hotel operations. Lead and develop the finance team, fostering a collaborative environment, and provide training and support on financial processes and systems. Collaborate with other departments to identify opportunities for revenue growth and evaluate potential investment opportunities and their financial implications. Communicate financial performance and strategies to stakeholders, including owners and management, and work closely with other departments to ensure alignment on financial objectives. Duties and Functions Direct and coordinate all activities of accounting personnel, including preparing management reports, financial statements, and related accounting reports. Oversee the receiving, storing, issuing, accounting for, and controlling the cost of food, beverage, general supplies, operating equipment, and fixed assets. Manage the requisition of equipment, materials, and supplies; handle the receiving, keeping, depositing, investing, and disbursing of funds. Prepare, control, and maintain all vouchers and cheques, process credit applications, and audit all hotel revenue reports. Ensure all accounting reports and financial statements comply with the uniform system of accounts for the hotel, and ensure accurate and timely submission of all accounting reports, financial statements, and tax returns. Collaborate with management and department heads on budgets and forecasts, maintain budget control procedures, and analyze financial statements. Maintain proper control systems and procedures, conduct continuous audits of hotel accounts, records, and transactions, and implement credit and collection policies. Ensure the maintenance of ledgers and subsidiary records for appropriations, expenditures, inventories, accounts receivables, accounts payables, operating equipment, and fixed assets. Supervise receiving, storing, and issuing functions to ensure proper procedures and controls, and assist department heads with budget preparation and feasibility studies. Maintain accounting machines and equipment, and foster good relations with banks and government entities for financial and regulatory matters. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in finance, preferably within the hospitality sector. Demonstrated experience in financial management, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting. Proven ability to lead and develop a finance team. Strong understanding of financial regulations, compliance, and risk management. Compensation A competitive salary and commission structure based on performance will be offered for this role.

6ff027e89990f5bd.description: About the Role Catrion is seeking a Manager, Risk & Business Continuity to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves collaborating with department heads and the executive team to develop and implement strategies for anticipating, addressing, and mitigating the effects of various business interruptions. The Manager will also oversee the organization's enterprise risk management program, identifying and assessing risks that could impact the company's reputation, safety, security, or financial success. Key Responsibilities Conduct risk assessments by analyzing documentation, statistics, reports, market trends, and potential impacts from business disruptions. Establish and maintain enterprise risk management and business continuity policies, procedures, risk registers, mitigation plans, business impact analyses, and crisis response and recovery playbooks. Review risk management policies and protocols, recommending and implementing improvements. Validate risk mitigation plans and assess their effectiveness. Recommend and implement appropriate risk treatments, including insurance, safety and security measures, business continuity arrangements, and recovery measures. Collaborate with stakeholders to establish risk appetite and tolerance thresholds for risk-based decision-making. Provide risk management advice and assessment support across the organization. Prepare and present risk reports, recommendations, and proposals to executive leadership. Develop, maintain, review, and enhance business continuity and recovery plans and procedures. Maintain the organization's risk management system, whether manual or software-based. Conduct business impact analyses for departments and critical functions to identify dependencies, recovery priorities, and disruption impacts. Plan, coordinate, and oversee business continuity and crisis management exercises. Collaborate with IT to establish practices for protecting and restoring data and systems following disruptions. Define and implement recovery strategies to ensure operational continuity. Document exercise scenarios, objectives, results, lessons learned, and corrective actions. Develop and deliver training and awareness programs on enterprise risk management, business continuity, and disaster recovery. Coordinate with Quality, Health, Safety and Security functions and relevant authorities to align emergency management plans. Engage risk champions to maintain accurate and current risk registers. Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual enterprise risk management reports. Monitor agreed risk and business continuity actions, escalate overdue items, and report implementation status. Promote risk ownership and process adherence across the organization. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in risk management and business continuity. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering operations in both Jeddah and Makkah. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

6f8ab0b21394d1e1.description: About the Role Pico Play is seeking an experienced Audio Visual Control & Lighting Engineer to join our team in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the delivery, coordination, testing, and commissioning of Audio Visual, Lighting, Control, and Show Control systems across complex projects. Key Responsibilities Review and coordinate AVCL design documents, specifications, drawings, equipment schedules, and technical submissions. Coordinate AV, lighting, control, show-control, and related specialist systems with MEP, ELV, ICT, architectural, and structural disciplines. Review shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, ITPs, calculations, and technical proposals. Ensure AVCL installations comply with approved shop drawings, project specifications, manufacturer requirements, and applicable codes and standards. Monitor site installation progress and inspect works to ensure compliance with approved documents and quality requirements. Coordinate system interfaces with BMS, ICT, security, fire alarm, electrical, lighting control, and other building systems where applicable. Support the development and review of testing and commissioning procedures and ensure system integration requirements are addressed. Prepare & Review testing and commissioning records, as-built drawings, O&M manuals, training documents, and final handover requirements. Ensure AVCL systems are properly integrated and functional prior to project handover. Maintain accurate technical records and ensure all AVCL documentation is managed through the approved project document-control/BIM platform. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in Audio Visual Control & Lighting engineering. The role requires a strong understanding of AVCL systems and their integration within complex projects. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Kharj, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The successful candidate will work within a project-focused environment, collaborating with various engineering and architectural disciplines. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6fd9bd83b5711b64.description: About the Role Haji Husein Alireza & Co. Ltd. is seeking a Product Support Sales Representative for a full-time position in Abqaiq (Buqayq). This role is responsible for providing comprehensive support to customers within a designated region, focusing on the promotion and sale of parts, accessories, and service offerings to achieve revenue targets and meet established budgets. Key Responsibilities Promote and sell parts, accessories, and service contracts to customers. Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide appropriate recommendations. Utilize sales techniques to close deals and achieve or exceed sales targets. Provide customer service by responding to inquiries, offering solutions, and addressing concerns. Build and maintain strong customer relationships to foster loyalty and repeat business. Listen to customer needs, offer advice, and tailor solutions to specific requirements. Conduct regular visits to customer stores for inventory check-ups to ensure availability of FMIs and prevent operational delays for their fleets. Stay updated on industry trends, product advancements, and competitive offerings. Communicate technical information effectively to customers, answering questions and providing accurate details. Process sales orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring proper documentation and fulfillment. Provide technical guidance and advice on service options, repairs, and installation processes. Collaborate with technical teams to address complex customer inquiries or issues. Gather market and customer insights through interactions and provide feedback to management regarding customer preferences, market trends, and competitor activities. Conduct monthly customer site visits to ensure fleet proper functioning, submitting reports that support upselling and advisory roles, reflecting dealer reputation and total customer support (TCS). Facilitate "3S" collaboration with service and sales departments by inviting at least three customers annually to showcase HHA's facility and brand capabilities. Generate at least two sales leads and forward them to the sales department to enhance regional coverage and position the company as a preferred supplier. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience in product support or sales. Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets. Strong customer service and relationship-building skills. Technical aptitude to understand and communicate product and service information. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Working Conditions The role requires flexibility to work in shifts, including weekends and holidays, as business needs dictate.

6f1c1f0d89ebc57e.description: About Midana Exploration Company Midana Exploration Company (MEC) is a resource exploration and development firm and a subsidiary of Hancock Prospecting, a leading private mining enterprise based in Australia. Operating within the Middle East's expanding mining sector, MEC focuses on developing the mineral potential of the Arabian-Nubian Shield. The company aims to transition high-potential exploration targets into operational mining assets by leveraging Hancock Prospecting's experience in exploration, project delivery, technology, and operational excellence, combined with local partnerships in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview: Senior Geologist, Generative Exploration The Senior Geologist, Generative Exploration, will lead prospect and campaign-scale generative exploration work packages. This full-time role involves converting regional concepts, prospectivity outputs, and field evidence into ranked, testable, and drill-ready targets. The position is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah and Makkah cities, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The successful candidate will maintain high standards of safety, data quality, and geological interpretation throughout all activities. Key Responsibilities Plan and lead prospect-scale mapping, sampling, prospecting, trenching, and first-pass drilling/target testing within approved Generative Exploration programs. Convert regional geological concepts and prospectivity outputs into explicit target hypotheses, field tests, decision criteria, and ranked follow-up recommendations. Plan and supervise integrated field activities using geological mapping, geochemistry, geophysics, and drilling to generate and assess exploration targets. Integrate field observations with geology, structure, geochemistry, geophysics, remote sensing, and historical data to build defensible regional-, camp-, and target-scale interpretations. Develop robust target models covering lithology, stratigraphy, structure, alteration, and mineralisation, updating ranking as new evidence is acquired. Utilise GIS, 3D modelling, and predictive-targeting/prospectivity tools to identify gaps, test alternative interpretations, and define high-value next field actions. Lead assigned geologists and field crews, ensuring safe, disciplined, and productive execution, complete field records, and reliable sample chain-of-custody. Apply sampling and QA/QC standards, validate field and laboratory data, and promptly escalate material geological, HSE, access, or data-quality risks. Prepare target sheets, maps, sections, concise technical reports, and campaign recommendations, and coach junior geologists in mapping, targeting, logging, and data-management practices. Work Environment and Location This is a field-based role requiring extended camp rotations during active Generative Exploration campaigns. Regular travel within KSA is expected, necessitating remote-conditions capability and practical 4WD/off-road awareness. Flexibility may be required as Midana’s KSA exploration portfolio develops and expands.

6f7f6f6f7a86baa6.description: About the Role Kempinski Hotel is seeking an Assistant Guest Relations Manager (Saudis only) to join their team. This full-time role involves managing the Guest Relations Section and ensuring the delivery of professional services in line with Kempinski’s standards. The Assistant Guest Relations Manager acts as a representative of the hotel management, addressing all guest relation matters to ensure guest satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Communicate the hotel and company philosophy and represent the hotel internally. Maintain in-depth knowledge of the hotel and the local geographical area. Stay informed about all in-house VIPs, hotel functions, and special events. Collect and distribute feedback on VIPs daily, utilizing resources like Google and Opera PMS, and ensure guest profiles are updated. Welcome, facilitate, and bid farewell to guests, with a focus on top VIPs who must be personally welcomed, escorted to their rooms, and bid farewell upon departure. Liaise with the Front Office Manager/Assistant Front Office Manager to prepare tailored itineraries for top VIPs and coordinate their greetings and departures in advance. Gather information about guest stays for entry into guest history records. Assist visitors with general information, internal promotions, and directions. Handle guest complaints and requests efficiently and politely, providing instructions to relevant staff to ensure optimal guest satisfaction. Maintain records of all complaints and requests, follow up, and inform concerned operating departments. Perform special projects and related duties as assigned. Recognize and engage appropriately with guests throughout the hotel. Attend and participate in daily briefings. Report and immediately rectify potential and existing hazards. Provide guests with information regarding hotel services and internal promotions. Inform Senior Management of any unusual circumstances affecting guest service and expectations. Make decisions on upgrades, complimentary services, or rebates according to hotel policies and procedures. Participate in training programs. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. The position requires a professional who can uphold Kempinski’s service standards and effectively manage guest relations. Work Environment This is a full-time position within the Kempinski Hotel. The role requires active engagement with guests and collaboration with various hotel departments to ensure a seamless guest experience. Additional Information Additional responsibilities and tasks may be assigned based on business and hotel needs. Salary details for this position will be disclosed during the application process.

6fbc8f336e82a5ad.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مترجم للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة العلوم اللغوية بلغتين على الأقل، مع التركيز على القواعد والمصطلحات والأساليب الأدبية لمواد الترجمة. يتضمن الدور إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة وحفظها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة أصول وقواعد ومصطلحات اللغة الأم من حيث المرادفات والصرف والنحو. دراسة اللغة الأجنبية من حيث مفرداتها وتراكيبها واشتقاقاتها. تحليل المادة المراد ترجمتها وتحديد أسلوب المعالجة المناسب. الاعتماد على مصادر وقواميس متعددة في عملية الترجمة لتحديد المعاني والمصطلحات بدقة في كلتا اللغتين. إجراء عملية الترجمة ومراجعتها وتطويرها لضمان الجودة والدقة. مواكبة التطورات في المصطلحات اللغوية في كل من اللغة الأم واللغة الأجنبية المترجم إليها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالترجمة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة، بما يتماشى مع السياسات والإجراءات المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الترجمة أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم عميق للعلوم اللغوية في لغتين على الأقل. إتقان قواعد ومصطلحات وأساليب اللغة الأم واللغة الأجنبية. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بالدقة والجودة في جميع أعمال الترجمة. القدرة على البحث واستخدام المصادر المتعددة بكفاءة. موقع العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

6f83659377d1140f.description: About the Program Caterpillar Inc. is offering a Field Representative Development Program in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time program is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience and serves as an entry point into a field-based career at Caterpillar. The program duration is 1 to 2 years, providing hands-on experience and training in collaboration with Cat® Dealers to serve customers globally. The start date for the program is February 1st, 2027. Program Structure and Activities The program begins with a three-month immersive cohort training, followed by 12-24 months of rotational assignments. Participants will engage in various activities to develop their skills and understanding of the business. Travel across the Europe, Africa, Middle-East, and Central Asia region to visit Caterpillar offices, Cat® Dealers, and customer sites. Gain insight into Caterpillar products, services, and industry strategies. Develop communication and leadership skills. Connect with a global network of peers and mentors. Complete rotational assignments in various organizational areas to broaden experience. Develop technical and commercial skillsets. Work on strategic projects. Prepare for a customer-facing field role. Career Opportunities Post-Program Upon successful completion of the program, graduates will be prepared for field-based roles supporting Cat Dealers and customers. An example of such a role is the Marketing and Sales Operations Representative. Collaborate with Cat® dealers to build capability and drive process improvement. Execute Marketing and Sales Operations related strategies. Design, architect, and implement improvement projects. Leverage data for storytelling and analysis. Craft a project portfolio to simplify and enhance practices. Develop solutions to support dealers in meeting customer needs. Program Benefits Participants in the Field Representative Development Program will receive structured support and development opportunities. A personalized development plan. Guidance from a dedicated coach. Hands-on technical, commercial, and soft-skill training. International exposure, including the opportunity for an international rotation. A defined path to impactful roles within the business. Recruitment Process The recruitment process for this program includes several stages designed to assess candidates' skills and motivation. HR Motivational Video Interview: An online interview via Microsoft Teams to understand the candidate's background, mindset, motivation, and passion. Business Interview (Targeted Selection Methodology): A structured behavioral interview with business leaders, focusing on examples of skills demonstrated. Business Acumen Interview: A conversation designed to assess real-time critical thinking, prioritization, analysis, and decision-making through on-the-spot business case questions. Work Environment This is a full-time position requiring 40 hours per week, primarily onsite five days a week in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role involves domestic and international travel throughout the program, with varying travel requirements based on program and assignment needs. Visa sponsorship is available for eligible applicants.

6fa568898e8db967.description: About Satel Satel develops premium residential communities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, catering to residents from diverse backgrounds. The company focuses on creating comprehensive living environments, including community events, facilities, and dedicated management teams to ensure a high standard of living for its residents. The Role of Leasing Specialist The Leasing Specialist at Satel is responsible for managing the commercial aspects of every lease agreement. This full-time role involves guiding prospective clients from initial interest to a signed contract, representing Satel at a critical decision point for clients. The position requires a measured approach, with clear next steps, timelines, and tracked outcomes for every interaction and deal. Key Responsibilities Managing the client journey from agreement in principle to signed lease contract. Negotiating lease terms within approved pricing guidelines. Ensuring a clear next step and date are established at the conclusion of every client interaction. Presenting the full commercial journey to the standard expected by Satel residents. Updating client statuses accurately and on the same day within the CRM system. Coordinating closely with the leasing team to ensure smooth progression of deals. Candidate Profile and Requirements Ability to command attention and listen effectively during client interactions. Understanding the importance of communication style in addition to content. Skill in firm negotiation without pressuring clients. Comfort in communicating with residents from diverse international backgrounds and adapting communication style as needed. Proactive approach to follow-ups, ensuring clients are always informed of next steps. Performance measured by signed contracts rather than the volume of conversations. Experience required: 5-10 years in a relevant field. Career Development at Satel Joining Satel means contributing to the development of residential communities in Riyadh. The company emphasizes transparent performance measurement and offers a clear career path from Leasing Specialist to Senior Specialist and into Leasing leadership roles. Application Information Satel invites applications from candidates who possess strong communication skills, demonstrate integrity in closing deals, and wish to represent a reputable brand. The salary for this position is not disclosed.

6f4a8000c4898460.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مطعم رنده عبدالعزيز جابر الطيب لتقديم الوجبات عن مساح كميات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تقدير التكاليف وإدارة العقود للمشروعات الإنشائية، مع ضمان الالتزام بالميزانية والإبلاغ عن أي انحرافات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع جداول الكميات وإعداد تقديرات التكاليف الدقيقة للمشروعات الهندسية. إدارة عمليات المناقصات والعقود، بما في ذلك مرحلة ما قبل الترسية وما بعدها. مباشرة المطالبات وإدارة عملية تغيير العقود لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة. مقارنة التقدم المخطط له مع التقدم الفعلي في سير العمل، وتحليل أي ثغرات أو مخاطر محتملة. مراقبة الميزانية والإنفاق على المشروعات والإبلاغ عن أي انحرافات في الموازنة بشكل فوري. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مسح الكميات أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تقدير التكاليف لمشروعات الإنشاء بدقة. فهم جيد لإدارة العقود والمناقصات. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في الموقع لمباشرة المهام المتعلقة بالمشروعات. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة. سيتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة.

6f5a6b3ea7874eec.description: About the Role Bechtel Corporation is seeking a Deputy Operational Risk Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the Operational Risk Manager in implementing and coordinating operational risk, security, and resilience programs across Saudi Arabia and the Middle East. The Deputy Operational Risk Manager will also act as the Operational Risk Manager during periods of absence, operating within formally delegated authority. Project Overview and Function Bechtel Saudi Arabia Company (SABCO) supports a diverse portfolio of projects and business operations throughout the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. The Regional Operational Risk function works with project leadership and functional organizations to maintain situational awareness, support informed decisions, and coordinate preparedness and response across projects and offices. This role contributes to the protection of personnel and assets and the continuity of operations through operational resilience, physical security, emergency preparedness, personnel accountability, crisis management, business continuity, and travel risk management. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation of operational risk, physical security, and resilience programs across SABCO projects and offices, maintaining procedures and coordinating activities under the Operational Risk Manager’s direction. Support corporate and project physical security threat and vulnerability assessments, site surveys, and inspections. Document exposure, control gaps, and recommended mitigations, tracking agreed corrective actions. Coordinate checks of access control, visitor processes, CCTV, and alarm arrangements with designated system owners. Liaise with guard-force providers on post instructions, coverage, observations, and service issues within delegated authority. Monitor security, geopolitical, travel, infrastructure, environmental, and operational developments, verifying threat information and assessing potential impacts. Support travel and journey risk assessments, destination briefings, movement tracking, and check-in arrangements, coordinating with travelers, projects, and approved service providers. Support security incident reporting and investigation activities by recording accurate timelines, gathering authorized information, and maintaining incident logs. Assist Incident Management Teams during incidents and disruptions through information gathering, verification, and dissemination, supporting emergency notifications and personnel accountability. Assist with business continuity planning, operational risk assessments, and resilience initiatives, maintaining emergency response plans and supporting documentation. Coordinate crisis management exercises, security and evacuation drills, tabletop exercises, and awareness briefings, capturing lessons learned and monitoring action completion. Coordinate with project leadership, functional organizations, corporate security, and service providers. Liaise with clients, local authorities, and law enforcement only when authorized. Prepare daily, weekly, and specialized reports, dashboards, analytical summaries, and management briefings using Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, and Power BI. Act as Operational Risk Manager during periods of absence, assuming day-to-day leadership of the operational risk and security function, coordinating personnel and operational priorities, and overseeing incident response and business continuity activities within formally delegated authority. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. The role requires practical security experience applied to assessments, inspections, incident coordination, and preparedness activities. Working Conditions This position is based in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Flexibility is required to support operations outside normal business hours, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays when instructed. Participation in on-call and standby arrangements and the ability to respond rapidly to incidents, emergencies, and business disruptions are essential. Occasional travel within Saudi Arabia and the GCC region may be required. 6fbf2fa473d78f4b.job_title: SAP Integration Consultant (SAP CPI)-Immediate Joining (3 Month)
6fbf2fa473d78f4b.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced SAP Integration Consultant with 6–8 years of experience to join an onsite team in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia , supporting an MRO Inventory Optimization project for a leading petrochemical client. Due to client security policies, the role requires onsite presence. The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on experience in SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) / SAP Integration Suite , with expertise in designing, developing, and deploying real-time integrations between SAP and external applications. The consultant will be responsible for defining integration architecture, building and deploying CPI integration flows, and supporting cybersecurity approvals and solution rollout across multiple plants. Key Responsibilities Define and document the overall integration strategy, architecture, and API approach for the solution. Design and document end-to-end integration architecture and detailed data flows between SAP and external systems. Analyze business and technical requirements to identify the most appropriate integration mechanisms. Build, configure, test, and deploy real-time integrations using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) / SAP Integration Suite . Develop and maintain integration flows for SAP Material Master and Inventory (MM) data . Design and implement integrations using OData, IDoc, BAPI, RFC, REST, and SOAP APIs . Assess and confirm whether custom developments or enhancements are required. Collaborate closely with business, functional, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration delivery. Support client cybersecurity review and approval processes, ensuring secure integration design and implementation. Estimate CPI message volumes, throughput requirements, and associated runtime costs. Perform integration testing, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. Implement monitoring, logging, and error-handling mechanisms to ensure reliable operations. Support deployment and rollout from the initial pilot plant to additional plants across the organization. Prepare technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and deployment guides. Technical Requirements Must-Have Skills 6–8 years of experience in SAP Integration and Middleware technologies. Strong hands-on experience with: SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) / SAP Integration Suite Development and deployment of CPI integration flows SAP Material Master and Inventory (MM) data integration OData, IDoc, BAPI, RFC REST and SOAP APIs Integration architecture and data flow design Proven experience in designing and implementing real-time SAP integrations. Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns and middleware architecture. Experience in technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and integration specifications. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) . Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA integration scenarios. Experience with secure connectivity mechanisms, including: SAP Cloud Connector OAuth Certificates and secure communication protocols Experience supporting cybersecurity reviews and security compliance processes. Familiarity with API Management capabilities. Experience in message monitoring, logging, exception handling, and operational support. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. SAP CPI / SAP Integration Suite certifications are highly desirable. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience working in industrial, manufacturing, oil & gas, or petrochemical environments is an advantage.

6f13786c45e58182.description: Role Summary The Quality Inspector – Mechanical is responsible for ensuring that all mechanical works—including HVAC, plumbing, drainage, fire protection, and mechanical equipment installations—are executed in full compliance with approved drawings, specifications, ITPs, and project quality procedures. The role involves daily site inspections, reviewing material and work inspection requests, and coordinating with engineers and contractors to maintain the highest standards of mechanical quality and safety on-site. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily inspections to ensure mechanical works follow approved ITPs, checklists, and project requirements. Proactively identify deficiencies, non-compliance, or faults in mechanical installations and report them immediately to the QC Manager for corrective actions. Close all WIRs (Work Inspection Requests) and MIRs (Material Inspection Requests) after obtaining proper signatures and ensuring supporting documentation is complete. Thoroughly review project specifications, mechanical drawings, PQP, ITPs, method statements, QC procedures, and related quality documents. Witness and document testing of mechanical systems (e.g., pressure tests, leakage tests, functional testing) and complete relevant forms. Monitor contractor practices related to mechanical quality control and safety compliance. Conduct daily meetings with the contractor's QC representative to ensure alignment with mechanical quality management procedures. Assist the construction team in resolving mechanical quality issues and technical challenges. Support the Quality Manager (QM) in preparing and conducting mechanical-related quality audits. Prepare daily QC reports and submit them to the QC Manager no later than 9:00 AM the following day. Verify that all mechanical testing tools and devices have valid calibration certificates. Review and maintain logs of WIRs, MIRs, MARs, NCRs, and other mechanical quality documentation. Highlight and report any mechanical miscoordination issues between disciplines to the Resident Engineer (RE) and Quality Manager (QM). Qualifications & Requirements 5–10 years of mechanical inspection experience, preferably in a PMC (Project Management Consultancy) environment. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline. Strong understanding of HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, mechanical utilities, and equipment installation. Ability to interpret mechanical drawings, specifications, and method statements. Solid knowledge of international mechanical codes and standards. Strong documentation, reporting, and communication skills. Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of resolving technical issues efficiently.

Verify quantities and work progress to ensure accuracy in completed work calculations. Coordinate and resolve mechanical design issues that arise during construction, working closely with all stakeholders, including contractors, to ensure alignment within the project scope. Lead commissioning, startup, and adjustments of mechanical systems and components, ensuring proper function. Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Minimum of 8 years of experience in verifying design against construction, QA/QC, material specification, Mechanical Systems commissioning mainly residential HVAC and plumbing systems. Strong experience in residential HVAC and plumbing systems. Knowledge of mechanical codes, standards, and commissioning processes.
